[[File:Yuuzhan_Vong_War_Vector_Prime.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The progress of the Yuuzhan Vong War from Vector Prime to the Battle of Fondor]]
'''Vector Prime''' was a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] term for the point in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] from which they [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invaded]] [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was close to outer edges of the [[Dalonbian sector/Legends|Dalonbian sector]], near the [[Helska system/Legends|Helska system]].

The [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] invasion started in Vector Prime as it was the only entry point known to the [[Yuuzhan Vong fleet]] that did not require use of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to penetrate the galaxy's [[circumferential hyperspace barrier]]. However, other Yuuzhan Vong suggested it had been chosen due to its proximity to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] border, which made both parties less able to respond.
